newsitem.title: USA: American Re to redeem debentures.
newsitem.headline: American Re to redeem debentures.

text.p: American Re Corp said on Wednesday that it plans to defease its existing issue of 10-7/8 percent senior subordinated debentures due 2004.
The company said it plans to redeem all then-outstanding debentures, which are currently $450 million in principal amount, around September 20, 1997, at 104.75 percent of par, plus accrued interest.
Funds for the redemption will be raised through a private offering of $500 million of the company's senior notes due 2026.
The company said it expects to complete the offering of senior notes by December 31, 1996.
